rows.Benefits Description.Covered medications: Network Retail Pharmacy All coinsurance is for up to a 30-day supply per prescription. Notes: • A generic equivalent will be dispensed unless you or your physician specifies that the prescription be dispensed as written (DAW), when an FDA approved generic drug is available. If there is no generic equivalent available, you will pay the brand name copay/coinsurance. • If you or your physician choose a brand name medication when a generic is available, you will be charged the generic coinsurance plus the difference in cost between the brand name and the generic. Your physician may call 855-240-0536, if they determine there is medical necessity for the brand therapy. If approved, your coinsurance will be the applicable brand name coinsurance. • Medications to treat some complex and chronic medical conditions are only available through CVS Specialty. See CVS Caremark
